subject: Confirm your PEC
body1: To confirm this PEC address as the platform digital domicile that SEND will use as the primary address for sending legally binding notifications, enter the code on SEND - Servizio Notifiche Digitali
footer: You are receiving this PEC because you entered your address as a legal address on SEND. To modify contact details or add new ones, href="${ENV.sendLoginUrlPF}recapiti"<#else>href="${ENV.sendLoginUrlPG}recapiti" style="color: #0073e6; text-decoration: underline">go to your contact details.
